placements.why: Reschedules orchard grafting from late March to the second half of February, grounding the shift in rootstock dormancy and previous trial take rates, superseding the frost-grounded late March cadence.
placements.title: Advancing orchard grafting into mid-to-late February rootstock dormancy
placements.frame: What seasonal rootstock conditions and empirical trial outcomes dictate the timing of orchard grafting?
